scientific_scope: Prospective P2 painted-trail mechanism selection after permanent P1-v1 closure. This record freezes a new transient response-engagement mechanism before implementation, simulation, parameter estimation, response-target search, or Y-maze access.

selection_rationale: This class has direct Lasius niger support for transient non-following/lapse behavior.
The same evidence argues against a stable specialist pheromone-ignoring caste, so the state must be redrawn between trials rather than attached persistently to an ant identity.
Candidate B relative/Weber bilateral transduction remains biologically plausible but is supported here only by cross-species evidence and is therefore not combined into P2-v1.
Selecting the minimal directly supported class first limits structural complexity and avoids using the P1 failed folds to invent a multi-mechanism rescue.

p1_closure_boundary.rule: P2-v1 is a new versioned structural hypothesis. It does not reinterpret P1-v1 as passing and may not reuse P1 held-out failures to set any new structural value, search bound, fold, weight, seed, or promotion threshold.

mechanism.concept: Each simulated ant independently draws a fresh trail-response engagement state once per simulation trial when a non-null painted-trail response is active. Engaged ants express the unchanged frozen local P1 steering kernel; lapsed ants express zero painted-trail steering for that trial. The state is not persisted across trials and is not a stable ant phenotype.

trial_level_engagement_state.draw_rule: For 0 < p_lapse < 1, draw exactly one U~Uniform[0,1) from the dedicated P2 response RNG for each ant at simulation construction after canonical ant initialization. engaged = (U >= p_lapse).
trial_level_engagement_state.within_trial_rule: The engaged/lapsed state is fixed for that ant for the duration of the simulation trial.
trial_level_engagement_state.between_trial_rule: No engagement state is persisted or reused between simulation trials, seeds, or experiments.

engaged_local_response_kernel.source_component: P1 frozen egocentric local steering kernel reused unchanged as a component, not as a promoted P1 result.

mechanism.canonical_update_order: When active and engaged, apply omega_trail*dt to heading immediately before the unchanged canonical Ant.update step, matching the previously audited P1 local-kernel ordering. Lapsed ants receive no trail heading increment.
mechanism.moving_step_rule: Trail steering is evaluated only on steps where the ant is not finished, is not already paused, and a preview of the canonical pause hazard indicates the ant will move; the preview clones biology RNG state without mutation.

dedicated_response_rng.purpose: Ensure stochastic engagement does not consume or perturb the canonical biology RNG stream.
dedicated_response_rng.response_rng_draws_per_ant: 0 under exact bypass cases; otherwise exactly 1 when 0 < p_lapse < 1.
dedicated_response_rng.seed_namespace_rule: response_seed = hash32((world_seed >>> 0) XOR Math.imul(ant_id + 1, 0x27d4eb2d) XOR 0x6c8e9cf5), then coerce zero to 1 exactly as core.RNG does.
dedicated_response_rng.rng_algorithm: Instantiate a separate core.RNG(response_seed) and use exactly one next() draw for the engagement state.
dedicated_response_rng.common_random_number_future_rule: If a later frozen P2 estimation policy varies p_lapse, all candidates evaluated under a given simulation trial seed must use the same response_seed and therefore the same underlying U, creating monotone common-random-number coupling across p_lapse values.

exact_identities.required_identity: Exact canonical locomotion trajectory and canonical biology RNG state; no field/sensor evaluation and no P2 response RNG draw.
Exact canonical locomotion trajectory and canonical biology RNG state; no field/sensor evaluation and no P2 response RNG draw.
Exact canonical locomotion trajectory and canonical biology RNG state under nonzero dose; engagement is deterministically false and no P2 response RNG draw occurs.

For identical sigma_field_mm, kappa_trail_per_s, model, apparatus, protocol, seed and dt, P2 trajectory must be exactly identical to the frozen P1 local-kernel trajectory; engagement is deterministically true and no P2 response RNG draw occurs. This nested identity is an implementation invariant only and does not reopen P1-v1.

invariances: No trail bearing, target direction, arena goal, or future path knowledge.
No speed modulation by painted-trail response.
No change to canonical pause, speed-noise, angular-noise, contacts, or boundary logic.
No H2, H3, H4, or H5 mechanism combination in P2-v1.
No Y-maze geometry, outcomes, or treatment labels.

sigma_field_mm.role: shared local field-width parameter inherited as an unchanged component of the frozen P1 local response kernel

kappa_trail_per_s.role: shared local steering-gain parameter inherited as an unchanged component of the frozen P1 local response kernel

engineering_only_reachability_values.p_lapse_basis: Approximate literature-motivated Lasius niger lapse/non-following anchor from the independently frozen Koch & Czaczkes evidence. It is not asserted to be the Poissonnier open-arena lapse probability and may not be treated as fitted evidence.

implementation_gate.next_step: A separate implementation + reference-free reachability PR may implement exactly this frozen mechanism and engineering panel after this record is audited and merged. It may not access the response target or Y-maze.

estimation_firewall.rule: No P2 estimation bounds, candidate panel, objective, folds, seeds, trial budget, promotion rule, or high-resolution authorization may be chosen from P1 failed-fold behavior. Any future P2 estimation policy must be a separate prospective freeze after implementation and reference-free qualification.
